sprint: 9 - Production Web Integration and Go Live Validation

no_phi_in_public_urls.evidence: Public routes serve marketing content only; no patient identifiers in URL patterns

no_phi_in_logs.evidence: LOG_FORMAT=json; no patient data logged in auth routes

no_hardcoded_credentials.evidence: No credentials in apps/web/src or backend/app source; dev defaults in config.py only

no_demo_accounts_in_production.evidence: NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE build guard; DEMO_MODE default false

no_mock_runtime_api.evidence: Frontend auth calls real /api/v1/auth/* endpoints only

no_cross_tenant_access.evidence: X-Organization-ID enforced; tenant scoping in backend queries — requires UAT-15 runtime verification

no_cross_patient_access.evidence: Patient routes scoped by user — requires UAT-14 runtime verification

no_insecure_direct_object_reference.evidence: Auth decorators on protected routes — requires UAT-14/15 runtime verification

no_automatic_result_release.evidence: Clinical workflow requires explicit validation, approval, and release actions in backend service layer

protected_report_access.evidence: Reports require auth; PDF not on public routes

secure_headers.evidence: next.config.ts security headers; backend SECURITY_HEADERS in security.py

logout_clears_session.evidence: POST /logout blocklists refresh token; frontend clears cookies and memory

payment_production_guard.evidence: get_payment_adapter blocks non-production-ready adapters in strict envs; MOCK_TEST production_ready=false

cors_no_wildcard_with_credentials.evidence: Wildcard blocked in strict env; explicit origins required

reset_password_disabled.evidence: POST /reset-password returns 501 RESET_NOT_ENABLED — not a security risk but functional gap
